mechanism:
v3 legacy structured path (README 'Legacy structured workflow'; prompts adjudication.md and synthesis.md):
- prepare, in code: validates the bundle and builds a candidate docket from word-analysis topics (must_integrate and candidate count as mandatory), QAC, channel nominations, HFT, reader walks and cross-run anchors. It assigns trust roles, and legacy_unbound material is marked selection-ineligible (adjudication.md:72).
- one adjudication call: exactly one decision per eligible candidate; mandatory candidates must be selected; a branch_review covers every focus branch as activated or unactivated, with an exact quote.
- one synthesis call: exactly one finding per selection, each needing a landing_quote in a paragraph.
- deterministic rendering of four files: prose, evidence, index and friction. Friction holds the full ledgers.
- Sizes: adjudication prompts of 155–314 KB (inputs/adjudication/s029/*.prompt.json: 69–143 candidates, 48–128 registered branches) and synthesis prompts of 79–147 KB. The Aug-28 synthesis limits were max_findings 48, max_paragraphs 16 and max_prose_chars 24,000 (inputs/synthesis/s029/*.prompt.json).
- Model: not recorded.

v3 prose-first authoring path (README stage list; ORCHESTRATION §2 and §6), all agents GPT-5.6 Luna at max (ORCHESTRATION.md:68):
1. Three fresh persistent scope reviewers in parallel: micro (focus surface plus every focus branch facet), macro (pericope, channel nominations, HFT) and global (reader walks, cross-run, reciprocal inter-ayah connections). Each returns an accounting ledger: surface_coverage, branch_screen with tested_facets, contact_opportunities, candidate_decisions, referrals and accepted_findings.
2. Deterministic conservation checks, then same-session validation repairs.
3. A fresh reconciler (prompts about 2.06–2.36 MB for 29:38) with repair turns and scope repairs.
4. Prose preparation in the same scope sessions, under the rule 'every locked finding' must land.
5. A fresh canonical merge writer: four first-pass files; its prompt embeds PRINCIPLES, COMMENTARY_SPEC, CHANNELS.md and the v2 PROMPT verbatim (scope-merge.md placeholders).
6. A same-session editorial follow-up (editorial-followup.md, byte-exact).
7. Turn receipts and workspace guards.
8. A fresh reader-map worker, never run.
9. A fresh invitation writer, never run.
10. A hash-bound completion manifest.
Handoffs are by absolute prompt path only. Every artifact is content-addressed and Git-staged.
Packet sizes for 29:38 (inputs/authoring/s029/29_38): micro review about 746 KB, macro about 757 KB, global about 1.45 MB, reconcile about 2.36 MB, scope prose 365–862 KB, merge 315 KB. Repair prompts about 0.8–1.3 MB each.
Code: about 33k lines of Python including tests (render_authoring.py alone is 11,975 lines).

v4 (README; ORCHESTRATION):
- prepare: derives the v3 docket in memory and projects the lanes. Each context member is a lean projection. The host S:0 basmala is mandatory in macro, and there are explicit --add-ayat, segments and pericope packages.
- Three fresh one-pass Luna-max scope authors (gpt-5.6-luna, max; ORCHESTRATION.md:125). Each decides every candidate, tests every branch/facet pair against the whole surface, reviews every connection and its evidence rows, and writes findings with Turkish draft_prose, one immutable prose_statement per finding and one per branch_activation.
- At most one same-agent repair.
- A fresh merge-only canonical writer (canonical.md:8: 'Your job is composition, not adjudication'). It copies a workflow-derived provenance ledger per finding into both evidence and index, and a landing map binds the exact sentences.
- A same-writer editorial pass, then mechanical verify.
- Sizes for 29:38 in the third generation (input/native/s029/29_38): micro prompt 831 KB, macro 983 KB, global 1.71 MB, canonical 1.29 MB. The branch_registry was 601–878k characters per lane (97–133 branches); global carried 253 connections.
- Code: about 11k lines.

north_star_scorecard.evidence: Every output opens on the plain sense: v4 29:38 gen3 prose 'Bu âyet Âd ile Semûd'u, geride bıraktıkları yurtların açık tanıklığıyla birlikte anar…'; v3 1:2 '1:2'nin açık cümlesi şudur…'. PRINCIPLES §5 grounding was embedded. Orientation is undermined by volume and morpheme-level treatment. v3 1:2 first pass has 4,060 words, 56 landing paragraphs and 75 locked findings for a four-word ayah (1_2.friction.tr.md density audit). v4 29:38 gen3 has 5,008 words and 285 sentences, with sentences for 'İlk وَ', 'İkinci وَ', 'Ara وَ' and 'Son وَ'. Recorded verdict (commentary-v5-review-2026-09-04.md:34): 'many repeated sentence frames and grammatical fragments'.

The v2 PROMPT asked for what Turkish cannot render (article doubling). Dictionary error_profile fields (loses/adds) were pushed for every contextual gloss. My count of sentences mentioning 'Türkçe': 0 in the v3 legacy, v3 authoring and v4 gen3 29:38 proses; 1 each in v3 1:2 ('teşekkür' does not carry ḥamd), v3 1:3 (the article on ar-Raḥmān) and v4 29:0 (bi- wider than 'ile'). Grammar was covered morpheme by morpheme because surface_coverage required every surface word (scope-micro.md), not 'only when it matters'.

A dedicated macro lane covered the pericope 'before/after' (v4/prompts/scope.md 'Active lane'). v3 29:38 editorial prose (git 08cdb7ec5) ties the ayah to 29:41 (spider house as bearing capacity), 29:19–20, 29:35, 29:44, 29:39, 29:45, 29:64–65, 29:67 and 29:69. v4 29:38 macro: 16 connections, 11 activated. Findings stay atomic, one per candidate, and the resonances appear as a sequence rather than a coalition.

Prohibited by design at ayah level: 'Layer 2 may not carry the surah's architecture or name a recurring surah-wide system' (COMMENTARY_SPEC@097b3e383 line 86); 'Name the image as an established surah-wide system' is listed under what you must not do (_ayah_commentary/v2/PROMPT.md:174); 'Do not introduce Layer 3, surah-wide channels, or network claims' (v3/prompts/editorial-followup.md:5). The v3 29:38 friction says 'yinelenen bir kanal veya sûre tezi adlandırılmadı' ('no recurring channel or surah thesis was named'). Channel reviews entered only as per-ayah candidates (4 in the 29:38 macro lane). No progressive disclosure of chains.

No concordance of a root's Quranic uses was pushed: the packet key tree shows only focus_root_occurrences and context_root_occurrences within the pericope or selected context. No prompt asks for a word's recurring Quranic role or where the canonical translation departs from it (scope-micro.md, v4/prompts/scope.md, canonical-prose.md).

The global lane reviewed reciprocal inter-ayah connections row by row. v4 29:38 global: 253 connections, 13 activated and 240 'no_return_path' (off-axis QeQ left out, as NS6 wants). Counter-evidence is kept (PRINCIPLES §9). v3 29:38 prose uses 7:201 as an antithetical parallel ('Daha çarpıcı olan, 7:201'de benzer bir karşılaşmanın kişiyi hatırlamaya ve açıkça görmeye döndürmesi…'). However, QeQ runs in parallel with the latent readings rather than after them, and relations are typed only as supports-primary or shifts-primary on surprise rows (COMMENTARY_SPEC §5), not as supports/expands/shifts/contradicts per finding.

The discovery material was present: v3 1:2 first pass has sentences on the well with crossbeam, water, herd/lead/stray and way-marks (my grep: 'işaret' 27 sentences, 'yol' 15, 'kuyu' 2). They were delivered as 75 locked findings in 56 paragraphs (aggregation). v4 forbids coalition: 'Do not place several merely related candidates into one generic finding' (v4/prompts/scope.md:33); the writer may not 'collapse' findings (canonical.md). S1 is confounded: docs/CHANNELS.md with the Fatiha water/well answer (lines 39, 60, 233) is embedded in the v3 merge and v4 prompts, and the dictionary registry of the 1:2 packets contains 'kuyu' ('well') 28 times. Recorded lesson (NORTH_STAR.md:134-135): 'every record must reach the prose' turns prose into a catalogue (v3).

There are verdicts per facet during discovery: v4 29:38 has 954 branch/facet dispositions, 882 of them 'no_independent_trigger'. Trust labels filtered in v3 legacy: legacy_unbound reader walks and HFT were selection-ineligible (adjudication.md:72), and the 29:39 friction rejects the retrospective surprises as 'bağlanmamış eski kayıt' ('unbound old record'). v4 gen3 had 0 uncandidate discoveries in all three 29:38 lanes (discovered_finding_refs empty). There is no coalition, maturation or reciprocal-reinforcement stage: findings are atomic and owned by candidates.

A containment field per finding and PRINCIPLES §4 were embedded; 'Do not rank accepted findings' (scope-micro.md). But the prose carries many negations. My count of değil/değildir/yoktur: 20 (v3 legacy 29:38), 25 (v3 authoring 29:38), 23 (v4 29:38), 43 (v3 1:2). There are 'not X but Y' frames, e.g. v4 'Buradaki engelleme, yolu ortadan kaldıran bir yıkım değil… uzaklaştırmadır' ('the blocking here is not a destruction that removes the road… but a turning away') and v3 legacy 'Buradaki içgörü çıplak gözle görme, kan, silah, taş ve dikiş değildir' ('the insight here is not naked-eye seeing, blood, weapon, stone or stitching'). Recorded (v5 review:33): V3 'accumulates negative qualifications'.

Anchors are strong in the apparatus. v4 branch_activations carry branch_ref, facet_id, carrier_refs, trigger_refs, focus_return_refs and an exact facet_statement (98 activations for 29:38, 27 for 29:0), and the v3 legacy branch_review quotes the exact contact support. Reader-prose Arabic spans {ar,tr,gloss} carry no source:S:A or root Bnnn. Memory-only senses are forbidden rather than marked ('Add no outside knowledge'), so a memory-sourced 7:201 became an invalid artifact.

'Nothing lost silently' is enforced exhaustively: every candidate, facet and connection row has a disposition and reason, the friction lists the excluded candidate ids (v3 29:38 friction), and 'no fallback may silently omit' (v3 README). But the v3 legacy trust labels filtered rather than ordered (legacy_unbound was ineligible for synthesis). Proper-name root plays were kept as 'controlled' readings (v3 29:38: Âd with return, Semûd with depletion; v4 gen3: 'عَاد adı, dönüş çağrışımını koruyarak… ironi'). Inference: that is close to a name etymology.

No surah commentary in v3/v4. Layer 3 was a separate workflow (_channel/layer3; COMMENTARY_SPEC §2). The closest artifact is 29:0 (basmala focus with all of S29 as macro context: 46 findings, 1,879 words), still framed as an ayah reading.

Luna max did everything, including synthesis. Prompts ran 0.75–2.36 MB per turn; S1 needed 99 repair turns (about 28M input tokens by my estimate) with no editorial completion; v4 gen3 wrote about 6.7 MB of apparatus per ayah. No Opus synthesis, Batch API or cached shared prefix design: persistent sessions were used instead. Costs were not recorded. About 44k lines of Python were built for loss prevention.

improvements.claim: An explicit, exhaustive branch review: every focus branch is decided activated or unactivated, with an exact contact excerpt, so rare dictionary senses are considered rather than left to memory.
improvements.evidence: v3/README.md (Adjudication 'ordered branch_review'); v3/outputs/adjudication/s029/29_39|40|41.response.json: 48/128/99 branch decisions, 4/13/6 activated; 29:39 friction 'Odak dal taraması: 48/48'. Recorded (v5 review:33): V3 'retains the eye-film and worked-road material'.

improvements.claim: A two-key activation contract made explicit: surface carrier plus distinctive facet plus an independent trigger (independent of the branch definition) plus changed reading and payoff. The North Star later endorses the 'two keys' idea.

failure_modes: Accounting replaces reading. Every candidate, branch/facet pair and connection evidence row must be decided and copied back (review_inventory), so the output budget goes to ledgers. v4 29:38 has 954 facet and 269 connection dispositions but 0 discoveries.
Repair loop on verbatim JSON re-emission. v3 S1 had 99 repairs, 37 of them caused by the repair itself changing content.

Conservation obligations become catalogue prose: each locked finding needs a landing; each surface morpheme gets a sentence ('İlk/İkinci/Ara/Son وَ'); immutable sentences are stitched together with near-duplicates.
Integration forbidden: findings are atomic and owned by candidates, and the merge-only writer cannot combine related readings (NS7/NS8 coalition is impossible).
Provenance used as a filter: legacy_unbound HFT and reader walks were excluded or qualified, and retrospective surprises rejected.
Lane walls: strict per-lane ref validation rejects correct cross-lane or pretraining references (7:201) and routes evidence wrongly (V5 review items 2 and 3).

Dictionary boundary fields leak into prose as negation lists: the branch boundary 'iç kavrayış ve kan, silah, taş ya da dikiş anlamları dışarıda kalır' ('inner insight and the senses blood, weapon, stone or stitching are excluded') reappears as v3 legacy 'Buradaki içgörü çıplak gözle görme, kan, silah, taş ve dikiş değildir' ('the insight here is not naked-eye seeing, blood, weapon, stone or stitching').
The Luna writer produces analyst register and English leakage ('discernment'in'; friction written in Turkish-English mix).
Surah chains prohibited at ayah level, so the NS4 progressive disclosure is structurally impossible.
Test contamination: S1 prompts include worked Fatiha answers (CHANNELS.md), confounding the discovery evidence.
Apparatus explosion: 6.7 MB of copied provenance ledgers per ayah (v4 gen3).
Artifacts deleted from the working tree (29:38 outputs removed in f74734ef4, the 29:38 v3 completion removed in f521fcd33), leaving the evidence only in git history.

Recorded: 'Exact preservation did not ensure good exposition' (v5 review:34). My counts come from the git files in the scratch dir.

More steps hurt (v3 to v4). The v3 authoring state machine (reconcile, scope repair, prose repair, receipts) completed 0 of 7 S1 ayat in 2 h 40 min or more with 99 repairs. The v4 one-pass path completed 29:38 and 29:0.

Bulk packets coincide with zero discovery. v4 29:38 lane prompts were 0.83–1.71 MB, with the branch registry 84% of the micro packet (600,831 of 714,968 chars), and there were 0 uncandidate discoveries. The V5 review item 4 calls this payload 'substantially larger than the discovery task needs'.
Pushed governing text primes: CHANNELS.md with worked Fatiha answers was embedded in the writer and lane prompts (v5 review:129-140; PLAN.md contamination).

Pushed data helped: the rare sabil 'red-veined web-like eye film' branch reached v3 legacy prose explicitly, as the dictionary branch registry supplied it. The water/well senses for 1:2 came from the registry ('kuyu' 28 times in the 1:2 packets).
Pushed data hurt: dictionary boundary/what_is_not fields turned into negation catalogues in prose (see failure modes), and prose negation counts are high (20–43 per ayah, my count).

Where the docket was irrelevant, the agent read freshly. 29:0 macro rejected all 69 context candidates and discovered 17 findings. Inference: the worklist itself, not the model, suppressed discovery at 29:38.
luna_evidence: Well: exhaustive, reasoned worklist compliance. For v4 29:38 every facet (954) and connection row (253 global plus 16 macro) has a specific reason. The v3 S1 micro reviews tested 562 facets (my count).

Well: its first-pass S1 1:2 contained the latent Fatiha images: water, the well with crossbeam, herd/lead/stray, way-marks and road. This is confounded by CHANNELS.md and the dictionary in the prompt.

Well: it discovers when the docket does not fit (29:0 macro: 17 discovered findings after rejecting 69 candidates). It also brought the correct antithetical parallel 7:201 from memory into the micro lane (git c64ab8234 failed artifact: 'Nadir kapanış biçimi 7:201'deki Şeytan temasından sonra hatırlama ve görme ile kurulan ilişkiye ters yönde…', i.e. the rare closing form runs opposite to the remembering-and-seeing that follows Satan's touch in 7:201).

Badly: synthesis. As canonical writer it produced catalogue prose: v3 1:2 with 56 landing paragraphs and v4 29:38 with 5,008 words, repeated frames, near-duplicate sentences and English leakage ('discernment'in'). Recorded in v5 review:34.
Badly: it could not reproduce large JSON verbatim across repair turns (37 of 99 v3 S1 repair issues were a repair rewriting prior content).

Badly: follows worklists over discovery. 0 uncandidate findings in v4 29:38. v3 S1 'new_findings' were 0–4 per lane, and accept+narrow ran about 85–100% of candidates (e.g. 1:7 macro 45 of 45 narrowed).
Badly: produced invalid refs and malformed rows (5 failed contribution artifacts in v4).
Sol and Astra were not used in v3/v4. The inherited v2 S100 comparison preferred gpt-5.6-sol max as writer (s100-default-writer-model-comparison).
pretraining_vs_data_evidence: Pretraining was enough, and the system punished it: the micro agent cited 7:201 ('when a touch from Satan… they remember, and then they see') for 29:38 mustabṣirīn without it being in the micro packet (7:201 occurs 0 times in micro.packet.json and 13 times in global.packet.json, my count). The hermetic validator rejected the contribution as 'invalid-unknown-7-201'. The same parallel is a highlight of the v3 authoring 29:38 prose.

Data was necessary: the rare sabil 'kırmızı damarlı ağsı göz perdesi' ('red-veined, web-like film over the eye') branch is a dictionary-only sense (NORTH_STAR names 'the eye disease in as-sabīl' as the kind of sense a model will not recall). It appears explicitly in v3 legacy 29:38 prose via the branch registry.

Data was necessary but confounded: the water-rich well and pulley senses for 1:2 are in the pushed registry ('kuyu' 28 times per 1:2 lane packet) and also in CHANNELS.md worked examples embedded in the prompts. Pretraining versus data cannot be separated for S1.

Pushed data dominating the prompt coincides with lost discovery. The registry was 600–878k chars per lane, much of it neighbor distinctions and contextual glosses (the V5 review estimates about 140k chars of neighbor distinctions and 66k of contextual glosses per lane).
Some boundary and what_is_not fields hurt: they became reader-facing negation lists.

key_lessons: Q1: v3/v4 put roughly 44k lines of Python and most model tokens into conservation: hashes, ledgers, per-facet dispositions, repairs and copied provenance. That bought traceability but not understanding. The lesson is the opposite of harvesting more machinery: the payoff sat in discovery and synthesis, which the machinery crowded out (0 discoveries at 29:38; catalogue prose).

Q1/Q4: 'Nothing lost' enforced as 'every record lands in prose' is the root of catalogue prose (NORTH_STAR.md:135). Losslessness belongs in a discoverable apparatus, not in the prose. The reader-map idea (never run) is the right split: core prose plus expandable detail.

Q1/Q4: Integration needs permission to merge readings into one concept (coalition). v4 explicitly forbade it ('Do not place several merely related candidates into one generic finding'; merge-only writer).

NS13: Luna at max follows worklists exhaustively and can discover when unconstrained (29:0 macro), but as writer it catalogues. v3/v4 put Luna on synthesis, contradicting the North Star economics lesson.

Q2a: Hermetic 'no outside knowledge' threw away correct pretraining knowledge (7:201). Pushed dictionary data was essential for rare senses (the sabil eye film), yet its boundary and neighbor fields leaked into prose as negations. Push senses and facets; let the model use and mark memory.

Q2b: v3/v4 left about 2,000 facet-level activation judgments with reasons across 12 ayat (562 S1 micro, 954 at 29:38, 294 at 29:0, 275 in the v3 legacy branch reviews), plus 269 connection-row judgments. The activation rate is about 8%. These are weak labels from one model family with no gold. Enough to prototype a scorer, not to train one alone.

Q3: V5, the Luna-generated base, inherits v3's docket and lane projector (v5/workflow.py:128-130). The V5 review traced lane misrouting and legacy_unbound mislabelling to that inheritance, so a new step on v5 should re-derive routing and drop provenance-as-filter.

Q5: The two-key record (branch facet plus an independent trigger in the window, plus a return to a focus word) is precise enough to become a script-computed candidate score before any model call. The v4 contributions give the schema and positive and negative examples.
S1 cannot validate discovery while CHANNELS.md or dictionary examples are in the prompt (PLAN.md D-f). v3 S1 and v4 ignored this.
The ayah-level ban on surah-wide chains (COMMENTARY_SPEC §2.2) made NS4 impossible in v3/v4. The current North Star reverses it, so no v3/v4 output can be used as evidence about chain disclosure.
